candidate.answerReason: The other 20 players must receive at least 300,000 dollars altogether, leaving at most 400,000 dollars. Paying those 20 players the minimum attains this bound.

methods.label: Reserve the other players' minimum salaries
methods.explanation:
To maximize one player's salary, first reserve the minimum amount owed to everyone else. There are \(21-1=20\) other players, whose combined salaries must be at least
\[
20\cdot15{,}000=300{,}000
\]
dollars. Therefore the chosen player's salary cannot exceed
\[
700{,}000-300{,}000=400{,}000
\]
dollars.

This bound is attainable: pay one player \(400{,}000\) dollars and each of the other players \(15{,}000\) dollars. Every player receives at least the minimum, and the total is exactly \(700{,}000\) dollars. Thus the maximum salary is \(400{,}000\) dollars, choice \(\boxed{\text{C}}\).
